messages.subject: Re: shiny server installation - no error but not working
parts:
- Are you trying to connect from the same machine, or a different machine? I wonder if the port is blocked.
- What do you see in /var/log/shiny-server.log file?
- What processes do you see when you run this command:

    ps aux | grep shiny
